Customer portal infrastructure: a web application running in containers (2 instances minimum), reachable over HTTPS on portal.example.com. It uses a PostgreSQL database (small, daily backups kept 7 days, not reachable from the internet), private file storage for customer uploads (encrypted, versioned, never public), and a secret holding the payment API key that only the application can read. Everything sits in a private network; only the HTTPS entry point is public. Tag everything with project=customer-portal and env=prod.
